facts.claim: Thresholded sign gating uses straight-through backward; if none selected, highest-score expert is enabled. Positive scores multiply expert outputs without expert-sum normalization.
facts.limit: This is not a convex member-probability selector and can change scale/confidence.

facts.claim: Expert outputs, with optional shared projection/norm, are stacked then positively weighted/summed. SAGMM wrapper applies one learned fc afterward.
facts.limit: Hidden versus class-coordinate outputs depend on last_layer/configuration and expert definitions; no literal IMDB5-BCE/native4 equivalence claimed.
